top_signals.title: Saudi Airport Attack Kills 12 as Conflict Escalates
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Middle East reporter Dan Williams tells Bloomberg This Weekend that an attack on Riyadh's international airport that killed at least 12 people and injured more than 300 marks a significant escalation in fighting between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Williams discusses the possibility of US military intervention, the threat to Saudi Arabia's investment ambitions and Iran's efforts to rebuild its missile arsenal amid uncertainty over renewed hostilities. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Putin relayed Iran war proposal to Trump, Kremlin says
top_signals.summary: Putin's reported call with Trump regarding the Iran war comes on the heels of a deal for the U.S. to buy Russian diesel amid a surge in fuel prices.

top_signals.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
top_signals.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
